title: Bates vs Wesleyan: tuition, size, location

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Wesleyan University and Bates College are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. Wesleyan University, located in Middletown, has a larger undergraduate enrollment of 3,067 students compared to Bates College's 1,760 students in Lewiston. Tuition costs also differ, with Wesleyan charging $70,342 for in-state students, while Bates' in-state tuition is slightly lower at $66,590. These distinctions highlight differences in size, location, and tuition between Wesleyan University vs Bates College, or Wesleyan vs Bates.

Overall, the cost comparison between Wesleyan University vs Bates College, or Wesleyan vs Bates, shows nuanced differences in tuition and student debt.
